headline: Hurricanes’ Taylor Hall to miss time with upper-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Hurricanes forward Taylor Hall will miss time with an upper-body injury, noting he had three goals and five points in eight games before he went down.

The production was backed by real play. So far this season, Hall's own expected goals (a measure of the quality of his chances) sit at 2.22 against his three actual goals, so he's running a little hot, but at 5-on-5 CAR took 63 percent of the expected goals with him on the ice, and the team's share runs 4.5 points better when he plays. He's been a second-line forward at 13 minutes a night, so his loss trims depth more than it breaks a lineup. CAR is 10-2-2 and controls 61 percent of expected goals overall, which should cushion it. Going by the five games already played without him, Nikolaj Ehlers has taken his spot beside Stankoven and Blake, Mark Jankowski is up to 17:16 a night from 14:10, and Jesperi Kotkaniemi is up to 13:27 from 11:19. Those two are the fantasy pickups to watch.
